findings.title: Resource/tool path escapes the server root (proven by canary file) -- tools/call read_file.filename (canary path)
findings.description: Contents of a canary file written outside the target root came back.
findings.remediation: Resolve the path and verify it is contained by an allowed root (os.path.realpath + prefix check / path.resolve + startsWith) before reading.

evidence.why_this_proves_it: response contains the contents of /tmp/mcpguard_canary_i2haqrrd.txt, a file written outside the target root. The server read a path that escaped its own directory.
